text:
maya: Anyone up for a quick after-work thing tomorrow? thinking sunset bento + short bike ride from Embarcadero? :bento: :bike:
ben: Love that idea. What time were you thinking? :rocket:
maya: 6:30pm for bento, meet at 6:20 by the Pier 7 benches. Bike ride ~30min after, casual pace.
olivia: 1️⃣ for sushi bento if were polling. Also can I bring my commuter bike? is there a rack?
sarah: I can make it but prob arrive ~7pm (work runover). Still fine to grab some food then?
devon: Count me in, bringing a portable speaker :notes: small speaker only. Ill grab some extra napkins.
ben: Quick poll — react with the number you want: 1️⃣ Sushi, 2️⃣ Vegan, 3️⃣ Mixed. Ill pre-order based on votes.
maya: cool. olivia noted allergy (gluten-free) — will get a vegan/gluten-safe option.
olivia: thanks! also recommend we park bikes at the small rack near the ferry kiosk — been fine there.
devon: Ill bring a small lock if anyone needs to secure theirs.
ben: linking a tiny RSVP sheet for counts: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-bento-rsvp (just put name + bike or no-bike)
eventbot: Friendly reminder: outdoor speaker OK but keep volume low after 8pm per park rules.
maya: Great — looks like 6 people so far. If anyone else wants in, add to the sheet. See yall tomorrow! :sunset:
olivia: Yay. bringing chopsticks if anyone forgets.
sarah: Bringing cash in case we need to tip the vendor.
devon: Also weather looks clear but bring a light jacket.
ben: If rain, fallback plan = park food court at Embarcadero Center (same time).
maya: noted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
